Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.1-These dangers were soon recognised and resulted in two international declarations—in 1874 in Brussels and in 1899 in The Hague—that prohibited the use of poisoned weapons.2-Though treaties were all made in good faith, they contained no means of control, and so failed to prevent interested parties from developing and using biological weapons. 3-Man has used poisons for assassination purposes ever since the dawn of civilisation, against individual enemies but also occasionally against armies.4-The foundation of microbiology by Louis Pasteur and Robert Koch offered new prospects for those interested in biological weapons because it allowed agents to be chosen and designed on a rational basis.
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given proverb.He who plays the piper calls the tune
options: Money is the source of all power.
Never tell people about your plans.
A person's success is determined by their connections.
A person who pays for something has the right to decide how it is done.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (A person who pays for something has the right to decide how it is done.) है।

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.The enigmatic structure of Stonehenge, rising on the windswept Salisbury Plain, continues to captivate archaoelogists with its precise alignment to the solstices, hinting at an advanced understanding of celestial cycles by its ancient builders, who left behind no written explanations of their motives or methods.
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given proverb.Jack of all trades, master of none
options: A person skilled in many areas and is often the best at everything
Someone who dabbles in many things but is not skilled in any
Someone who gains multiple skills to succeed
Someone who is uninterested in learning new skills
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Someone who dabbles in many things but is not skilled in any) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.The human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) is a viral pathogen that specifically targets the immune cells responsible for combating infections, hence compromising the individual's ability to ward off other infectious agents and diseases. HIV is transmitted through the exchange of specific bodily fluids, most often during unprotected intimate contact and through the sharing of injection drug equipment. In the absence of medical intervention, the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) has the potential to progress into acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). The human body is unable to eliminate the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), and now, there is a lack of an efficacious cure for HIV. Fortunately, there exists a viable remedy in the form of HIV medication, commonly referred to as antiretroviral therapy or ART. When adhered to as directed, antiretroviral therapy (ART) has the capacity to significantly diminish the concentration of HIV in the bloodstream, commonly referred to as the viral load, to a state of minimal magnitude. The phenomenon being referred to is commonly known as viral suppression.Q76. Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
